presets.name: Slow Air
presets.bridge_strategy: Use a low-intensity glass scaffold; keep motion sparse and leave performance headroom.

presets.name: Deep Bed
presets.bridge_strategy: Use hollow at low intensity; favor a stable bed over foreground events.

presets.name: Distant Events
presets.bridge_strategy: Use hollow with conservative contrast; add space through the project template, not guessed graph edits.

presets.name: Soft Drift
presets.bridge_strategy: Keep the draft quiet and slowly changing; never fill every exposed control.

presets.name: Night Motion
presets.bridge_strategy: Use ember as a warm scaffold and keep pitch movement bounded by the user's scale.

presets.name: Layered Motion
presets.bridge_strategy: Use medium intensity and one contrast control at a time; verify after each revision.

presets.name: Pulse Lab
presets.bridge_strategy: Use acid at higher intensity only on a disposable project; treat generation as a reversible gesture.
